line: docs/PROSPECT_ANCHOR_GATE.md: the realized anchor's one look
estimand: D_i = label_i / 6 - fv_to_6yr_avg_war(fv_i), WAR per season, over the resolved rows of cell C; the gate asks whether |E[D_C]| lies inside a tolerance fixed in section 5.4. Positive D_C is realized ABOVE the anchor.

label_stamps.anchors_provenance:
SUB-45 KNOTS RE-AMENDED 2026-10-03 for the fWAR LABEL EPOCH (docs/efv-2026-09-17/FWAR_LABEL_EPOCH_GATE.md, runbook step J), by the same construction as the 2026-07-29 and 2026-09-04 amendments and for the same reason. `value_framework --fit` cannot emit these knots (its tier list starts at 40, its public-reference fallback hands 20/25/30 the FV35 reference, its flat 0.50 public blend keeps FV40 half-prior, and its round(v, 2) collapses every sub-45 value), so the epoch's routine refit reverted the table to a single constant across FV20..40 again, one declared production value for most served rows. test_empirical_anchors.test_low_end_anchors_are_present_and_measured is the tripwire.
RE-MEASURED ON THE fWAR LABEL (published FanGraphs WAR, frozen vintage, RESOLVED_THROUGH 2026), resolved matrix pool, both sides, target_censored over 6, knot cell |FV - knot| <= 1.25, seed 20260807, B 2000: FV35 0.0143 WAR/yr CI95 [0.0061, 0.0237] n=721; FV40 0.0703 CI95 [0.0535, 0.0891] n=1263. The eWAR v2 measurements they replace: FV35 0.0069 n=704, FV40 0.071 n=1201. A different label is a different definition, not a gain in accuracy (gate clause (l)).
The 20/25/30 knots remain EXTRAPOLATION, not measurement: the resolved pool has no rows below FV32.5, so they are the minimal monotone ramp under the measured FV35, holding the 2026-07-29 ramp SHAPE and rescaling it to the new knot. Treat them as a floor, not a finding. 45 through 80 are the epoch refit's own output and are not touched here.
STANDING TRAP: any future `value_framework --fit` reverts this again. Re-apply after every fit; docs/efv-2026-09-03/WAR_BASIS_RUNBOOK.md step J says so.

frame_integrity.L3: Only rows with censored == False enter any cell. No tail-projected label enters.
frame_integrity.L4: A never-debuted prospect is a 0, not a missing value, and a debuted prospect's absent season inside his window is a 0.
frame_integrity.L7: The artifact carries no field read from data/mlb_projections.json, no proj_ml output and no warChamp.

H.definition: resolved rows whose player_key is NOT in the anchor's fit cohort

S.definition: resolved rows whose player_key IS in the anchor's fit cohort

method.statistic: D_C = mean over rows of label_i / 6 - anchor(fv_i). R_C = mean(label_i / 6) / mean(anchor(fv_i)), reported, never adjudicated. Interval: percentile bootstrap over rows, B = 2000, seed 20260923, two-sided 90 percent.
method.floor: A cell carries a verdict only with n >= 40 resolved rows on the frame being read. 40 is anchor_calibration.min_n_robust. Below 40 the cell reads UNPOWERED and publishes its n and its point estimate without an interval.
method.bootstrap_unit: rows (players; cross-side key overlap is 0 by L2)

power.criterion_mde95: MDE95 = 1.645 times the bootstrap standard error of D_C, the standard deviation of the B bootstrap draws of D_C, and NOT the residual sd of the rows.
power.criterion_detection: A design-matched simulation planting a residual of exactly +m_C at each powered cell with the cell's own residual sd and n, B = 1000, seed 20260923; the fraction of simulated runs returning MISCALIBRATED is published, and a cell below 0.80 is labelled as one where a MISCALIBRATED verdict would be a lucky read, without changing its disposition rule.
power.criterion_coverage: A two-sided coverage check on the bootstrap interval itself, n_check >= 200, at the cell's n: a too-NARROW interval manufactures CONFIRMED, the direction the check exists to catch.
power.margin_pin: A look-day m_C outside 0.75x to 1.25x of the design-day figure at any cell requires an amendment filed BEFORE the look; without that amendment the look is not taken.

45.criterion: m_C = ( anchor(k_C + 2.5) - anchor(k_C - 2.5) ) / 2, on the served table at the look (for the 65+ cell, at k = 65).

50.criterion: m_C = ( anchor(k_C + 2.5) - anchor(k_C - 2.5) ) / 2, on the served table at the look (for the 65+ cell, at k = 65).

45.range: 45 [42.5, 47.5); 50 [47.5, 52.5); 55 [52.5, 57.5); 60 [57.5, 62.5); 65+ [62.5, 80]. Each row's assigned level is the anchor at ITS OWN FV, never the knot value.

criteria.CONFIRMED: n >= 40 and the 90 percent interval on D_C lies entirely inside [-m_C, +m_C]
criteria.MISCALIBRATED: n >= 40 and the interval lies entirely outside the band on one side, after the Holm step in 6.3; the sign is published
criteria.UNPOWERED: n < 40, or the cell's MDE95 (1.645 times the bootstrap standard error of D_C, the sd of the B draws, never the residual sd of the rows) exceeds 2 * m_C, in which case the cell is labelled UNDECIDED_UNDERPOWERED and counts as unpowered for 6.2
criteria.holm: Family H: the powered cells on frame H, at most five. Family S: the powered cells on frame S, at most five. Two families, each under Holm at family alpha 0.10. p_C: if d_C > +m_C, p_C = 2 * (fraction of bootstrap draws with D*_C <= +m_C); if d_C < -m_C, p_C = 2 * (fraction with D*_C >= -m_C); otherwise p_C = 1. A cell with d_C on the wrong side of the band reads UNDECIDED whatever its p_C.
criteria.concordance: A cell that reads MISCALIBRATED on H, where S is ALSO powered at that cell and S's 90 percent interval on D_C lies entirely on the opposite side of zero from H's point estimate d_C, reads UNDECIDED at that cell, with both frames' numbers published and the cell labelled SOURCE_SCALE_SUSPECT.

verdict_criteria.verdict_MISCALIBRATED: MISCALIBRATED if ANY powered cell on H is MISCALIBRATED under the Holm family and survives the concordance rule, OR any powered cell on S is MISCALIBRATED under its own Holm family.
verdict_criteria.concordance: A cell that reads MISCALIBRATED on H, where S is ALSO powered at that cell and S's 90 percent interval on D_C lies entirely on the opposite side of zero from H's point estimate d_C, reads UNDECIDED at that cell, with both frames' numbers published and the cell labelled SOURCE_SCALE_SUSPECT.
verdict_criteria.verdict_CONFIRMED: CONFIRMED if EVERY powered cell on H is CONFIRMED, no powered cell on S is MISCALIBRATED, AND the powered cells on H include at least 45, 50 and 55.
verdict_criteria.verdict_UNDECIDED: UNDECIDED otherwise, with every cell's disposition published.

sentence: The realized anchor is UNDECIDED at FV cells ['45']: the interval on the realized-minus-assigned level crosses the tolerance band. Nothing served moves. The question re-arms when RESOLVED_THROUGH reaches 2027 under a new registration that discloses this read. UNDECIDED is not a confirmation and no copy may treat it as one.
unconditional_sentence: Every number here is on the published fWAR label frozen per season. It is a statement about that definition of WAR. The anchor's agreement or disagreement with it is not evidence that the label is more or less accurate than any other.
